ctx.x: And Bobby Tucker would go in the booth, you know, and be like the producer. And we'd both begin to learn Billy so well, we knew him, so when he would want to go to Vegas he'd take me with him and leave Bobby back in Jersey, instead of just shipping him out for a day or two.
